prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop homepage composition for Josh King, a product designer. Render only the actual edge-to-edge web page canvas at roughly 1536×1024 landscape—no browser chrome, device, desk, presentation board, mockup frame, or surrounding environment.

This is option 3 of a canvas-first design study: "Offset type field." Build a sophisticated asymmetric homepage using only typography, negative space, proportion, and alignment. The background is flat near-black (#080909). No imagery of any kind.

Treat the words themselves as the composition, without enclosing them in boxes. Place "JOSH" large in the upper-left quadrant and "KING" large but offset farther right and slightly lower, creating an intentional broken-name rhythm across the canvas. Place "PRODUCT" small above a large "DESIGNER" in the lower-left quadrant, with DESIGNER extending toward center but never colliding with the name. Use Montserrat uppercase for all major display words in warm white (#F2F0E9). Thread restrained DM Sans utility text through the negative gaps: "DESIGN · CODE · AI" near center-right; a horizontal top navigation "WORK   LAB   ABOUT   CONTACT" aligned to the upper-right edge; and "VIEW LATEST WORK" anchored near the lower-right corner. Add exactly one thin mint (#A7E0C3) horizontal rule beside VIEW LATEST WORK, not beneath any other text. A tiny "02 / 03" can sit at the bottom-left as a text-only index.

The design must use an invisible grid rather than visible divisions. It should feel like an art-directed typographic poster translated into a usable digital portfolio: minimal, controlled, clean, premium, slightly offbeat, and highly legible. Font families are Montserrat for display and DM Sans for supporting text. Flat colors only: near-black, warm white, muted gray, and mint only for the active mark.

STRICTLY EXCLUDE: photos, screenshots, UI thumbnails, client names, company logos, icons, illustrations, objects, symbols used as metaphors, narrative scenes, textures, noise, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, shadows, cards, panels, boxes, rounded rectangles, bento grids, visible columns, side borders, eyebrow headings, serif fonts, invented awards or claims. Do not include "41 Realty", "The Viv", "Reserve", "StormForge", or any other client brand. Only use this visible copy: JOSH; KING; PRODUCT; DESIGNER; DESIGN · CODE · AI; VIEW LATEST WORK; WORK; LAB; ABOUT; CONTACT; 02 / 03.
